messages:
Maya (CEO): Quick weekly update — product GA timeline, cost targets, and a couple of asks.

Maya (CEO): TL;DR:
- Private GA on track for Apr 15 (feature-flag gating only contains rollout to Dedicated customers)
- p95 latency target: 120ms (current p95 142ms)
- MRR growth MoM: +23%
- Unit cost: search workloads are ~18% above target

Maya (CEO): Key asks:
1) Eng: bring per-token cost in search funnels down by 10% within 3 sprints; focus on KV cache hit-rate and batching.
2) Product + Sales: finalize Dedicated pricing updates and field FAQ for enterprise customers.

Maya (CEO): Quick metrics snapshot (current week):
```
GA_target_date: 2026-04-15
p95_latency_ms: 142
error_rate_5m: 0.18%
MRR: $1,280,000
committed_enterprise_customers: 7
cost_per_1M_tokens: $42.10
```

Maya (CEO): Incident note — Wed 14:12 UTC: 45m degraded KV-cache performance affecting hosted inference (search-heavy customers). Mitigated by rolling back autoscaler policy on xpool. No data loss. RCA due Mon from eng-runtime.

Ravi (VP Eng): Acknowledged. I'll spin up a small task force: batching + cache tuning. Proposal with estimated impact by EOD Fri.

Lina (VP Product): I'll attach the Dedicated pricing draft in Confluence and tag Sales. Need input on SLA language.

Jenna (Head of Sales): On it — I'll run a quick partner pricing workshop Thurs 3pm and share notes. Can we get an example field FAQ for support?

Kai (Finance): Agree with the cost target. Finance needs the projected savings timeline for FY plan (numbers by next Wed pls).

OpsBot (deploy-bot): [deploy] prod/private-control-plane v2.14.1 deployed to eu-west-1 — 0 failures.

Maya (CEO): Thanks all. Short company sync Friday 10:00am PT — include eng-runtime, product pricing, and sales ops. Please surface any blockers by Thu noon. :thumbsup:
